source: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data (Open Government Licence)
filter: PPD Category A only; postcode required; Date of Transfer within window
notes: Scotland and Northern Ireland: PPD covers England and Wales only.

Window is 12 whole calendar months (1st to last day), ending on the latest month that ended at least 6 months before the generation date, so recent registration lag does not under-count the newest month. Figures count HM Land Registry REGISTERED sales in that window.
